title: Feysa and Kipruto triumph in swift Chicago races

story.W: Very fast from the start (2:11 pace). Hawi Feysa and Brigid Kosgei broke away early but were caught by halfway (1:06:06). Feysa and Sharon Lokedi then ran side by side for more than an hour until Feysa surged in the last mile and won by 34 seconds. Three women broke 2:15 in one race for the first time.
story.M: Six men reached halfway in 1:00:21, faster than the split in the world record run. Jacob Kiplimo attacked after 25 km and only Amos Kipruto followed; Kipruto moved ahead from mile 20 and Kiplimo faded with a hamstring injury.

performances.name: Hawi FEYSA
performances.note: Retained her title in 2:13:33, fourth-fastest in history and 84 seconds off her best. Led early, was caught, then broke Lokedi with a surge in the final mile.

performances.name: Sharon LOKEDI
performances.note: Second in 2:14:07, a big personal best and eighth-fastest in history. Closed an early gap, led at 30 km, and ran level with Feysa until the last mile.

performances.name: Brigid KOSGEI
performances.note: Third in 2:14:55 after going clear with Feysa early; lost contact with the front two before 30 km.

performances.name: Amos KIPRUTO
performances.note: Won in 2:01:09, a 30-second personal best and equal fifth-fastest in history. The only man to follow Kiplimo's attack; went ahead after mile 20 and won by almost two minutes. Third in 2024, second in 2025.

performances.name: Jacob KIPLIMO
performances.note: The pre-race favourite and defending champion broke the field after 25 km, but pulled a hamstring, faded from 35 km and finished fourth.

performances.name: Tadese TAKELE
performances.note: Called Tadese Bikila in the report. Finished strongly for second in a personal best of 2:02:56, passing Kiplimo late.

performances.name: Milkesa MENGESHA
performances.note: Came through late for third, passing Kiplimo.

performances.name: Vincent MAURI
performances.note: Ran alone ahead of the second group, on course for under 2:05 at halfway, then stopped briefly with apparent cramp after 21 miles; finished tenth.
